verdict.rationale: Langfuse explicitly documents a native OTLP endpoint (/api/public/otel) for receiving traces, alongside native SDKs, confirming non-proprietary OpenTelemetry ingestion. missing for 10: no evidence of Langfuse sending/exporting traces out via OTLP (only receiving is documented), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of OTLP interoperability in practice.
